items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: Yellow, as far as I know, didn't play in a cab right where I was.

ctx.x: I was wondering if, you know, they'd add a clarinet and a black cat or would they have any blowing up?
No, no. Yellow, as far as I know, didn't play in a cab right where I was. Oh, yeah. I doubt if he could play for the singers in those days.
Well, what about other violin players like Max Fink? Did they have many good ones other than there?
